# Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors in Kenya: how the programme works and what you get

Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors (MLSA) is a global programme for university students who want to learn and teach Microsoft technologies. Kenyan students apply online, complete learning paths on Microsoft Learn, and host events at their universities.

...

In Kenya, there are active ambassadors at universities across the country.

Unlike [GDG on Campus](https://mctaba.com/campus/gdg-on-campus-kenya) , where each campus has one appointed lead, the MLSA programme accepts multiple ambassadors per university. You are an individual ambassador, not a club leader, although many ambassadors end up running campus events together.

The programme is structured around milestones. You start at the Alpha level and progress through Beta, Gold, and eventually Gold with distinction, based on the events you host and the learning paths you complete.

## How to apply

Applications are open year-round on the Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors website.

To apply, you need:

* A valid university email address or proof of enrolment
* A Microsoft Learn profile (free to create)
* A short application explaining why you want to join and what community activities you have done

The application does not require you to be a coding expert.
